title: Interest Rate Reversal? (Mid Term Seasonality)
speaker: Matt (Trade Brigade)

macro_themes.view: Expects 10-year rates to flatline in October and then fall, as in 2018, supporting small caps and bonds.
NFP missed (29k vs 89k) but household survey +406k signals a strong labor market, pushing rates up.
Breadth is washed out to tariff-crash levels; a catch-up snapback rally could fuel a sustained breakout.
Talk of inflating the debt away and $5,000 checks makes the bond market sensitive; rates rose on it.
Fed funds futures ~78% pause; hikes being unwound in a dovish direction.
